text_markup: {card:Tinkering}'s play ability reads, "Choose a piece of ice. That ice gains {subtype:sentry}, {subtype:code gate}, and {subtype:barrier} until the end of the turn." The first sentence does nothing except direct the Runner to select a target, so it forms a single instruction with the second sentence. The target is chosen as the instruction becomes imminent, and the card gains the subtypes when the instruction resolves.
